name: Cinch Home Services
notes: Researched from the public Cinch Home Services homeowner FAQ and the public My Account sign-in page only (never signed in). Plans are paid monthly or annually; the first charge is made when the plan becomes active, to the payment method provided. My Account (account created with the plan/contract number, then email verification and password) lets members download plan documents, open and check service requests, change the payment method (credit card or bank account), update contact details, and renew or cancel. Renewals: automatically renewing plans give at least 30 days' notice of rate or coverage changes. Cancellation is online in My Account or by phone at (800) 474-4047: within 30 days of the effective date with no claims, a full refund; after a claim, a cancellation fee plus the lesser of the remaining annual premium or paid claims (amount of the fee not published). A deductible is due per service trade when you request service (not a bill-payment fee). AutoPay is the recurring plan charge to the method on file (no separate enrollment described); turning it off is not described, so autopay_cancel stays at the family default. Moved from utility-account to streaming. Prices vary by region, so the plan page keeps synthetic plans. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): homeowner FAQ re-read; the Contact Us page repeats the renew/cancel line (800) 474-4047 and the online cancellation option.

autopay.note: Monthly or annual plan payments are charged to the payment method on file. You can change it to a different credit card or bank account in My Account.

cancel_service.note: You can also cancel by calling (800) 474-4047. Cancel within 30 days of your coverage start date with no claims for a full refund.

notes: Cancelling after a claim has been made can include a cancellation fee; Cinch does not publish the amount.

help.title: Payments and billing
paragraphs: You can usually choose to pay monthly or annually. Your first charge is made when your plan becomes active, to the payment method you gave.
In My Account you can change your payment method to another credit card or bank account.

help.title: My Account and renewals
paragraphs: After you buy a plan, create your account with your plan (contract) number, then verify your email and set a password. My Account lets you download plan documents, open and check service requests, change your payment method and update contact information.
If your plan renews automatically, Cinch tells you about any rate or coverage changes at least 30 days before your agreement ends.
A deductible is due when you request service, and it applies per service trade, so plumbing and electrical issues each have one.

help.title: Cancel your plan
paragraphs: To renew or cancel, use My Account or call (800) 474-4047.

Cancel by phone or in writing within 30 days of your coverage effective date for a full refund of contract fees, as long as no claim has been made. If you cancel after a claim, you may owe a cancellation fee plus the lesser of the rest of the annual premium or the claims paid. Full terms are in your plan documents.

extra.intent: Using the Cinch FAQs, find how many days before your agreement ends Cinch tells you about rate or coverage changes on an auto-renewing plan. Do not change anything.

solution.text: At least 30 days before the agreement expires.
